The menu

House favorites.

A rotating selection of what’s moving at the counter right now. Build a pickup bag here and we’ll have it ready at the register — pay when you pick up, and bring a valid ID.

Looking for something specific? The full live menu — every brand and every deal — is on Weedmaps, or call the shop at (866) 272-6799 and a budtender will check the shelf for you.

03

The shop

Rooted in the culture.

Erb & Arbor is a premier cannabis retailer with a simple idea: celebrate the pioneers who built cannabis culture — and take the time to educate everyone discovering it now.

That means no rushed counters and no dumb questions. First time in a dispensary? A budtender will walk you through flower, edibles and ratios until you find your fit. Been around since before it was legal? You’ll find the heavy hitters and small-batch drops you actually came for.

Medical patients and recreational customers are both welcome, seven days a week, with a wide variety of quality products — flower, edibles, CBD and more — at prices that keep the neighborhood coming back.

— The Erb & Arbor family, Panorama City

04

Deals

First visit? On us.

Standing offers for the neighborhood — starting with the one every first-time customer should know about.

First-time customer deal

Your first three orders, your choice.

New to Erb & Arbor? On each of your first three orders, pick one of the three for just a dollar. It’s how we say welcome to the neighborhood.

Minimum purchase applies. One per order, first three orders only. Ask a budtender in-store or check the listing on Weedmaps for full terms.

$1Indoor Eighth3.5g of house indoor flower
$11g VapeA full-gram cartridge
$1100mg EdibleA full-strength gummy pack

Daily specials rotate in-store — flower deals, cart days and happy-hour pricing post at the counter and on Weedmaps. Deals cannot always be combined; the register has the final word.

05

Why this door

A budtender’s shop, not a warehouse.

a.Learn something

Education is the house policy. Ratios, terpene profiles, onset times — ask anything and get a straight answer, whether it’s your first edible or your five-hundredth eighth.

b.Order ahead, skip the line

Build your bag on the menu above or on Weedmaps, and it’ll be waiting at the pickup counter. In and out — no standing in the Saturday line.

c.Easy to get to

Right on Van Nuys Boulevard across from Panorama Mall, next to the LA Kings practice facility — with plenty of parking, so the trip never starts with a circling-the-block ritual.
